svg.title: Shorted superconducting coaxial line
svg.desc: Axial section and cross-section of a shorted coaxial line driven by a radial surface current on one end cap, with the field and current profiles across a one-sided London film of thickness d and penetration depth lambda.
svg.text: Cross-section, seen from the driven end
